newsitem.title: UK: EDS wins Electronic Broking Services deal.
newsitem.headline: EDS wins Electronic Broking Services deal.

text.p: U.S. firm Electronic Data Systems Corp said on Tuesday it had won a contract from Electronic Broking Services worth an expected $700-900 million in revenues over a 10-year period.
Under the contract, EDS will manage the service's global dealing network.
Electronic Broking, which is owned by a group of major international banks, provides services for interbank spot foreign foreign exchange.
EDS said it will provide technical infrastructure services and global logistics management as part of the deal.
In some major money centre locations, for example, EDS will provide 24-hour field service and rapid-response teams within one hour of a service call during trading hours.
